items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...ask Mr. T.O. if you remember your, uh, uncle... INTERVIEWEE: That's right. He was a conductor of a symphony orchestra.

ctx.x: What is he not going to do? He ain't doing nothing. It's a trick in all that stuff.
Well, I was going to ask Mr. T.O. if you remember your, uh, uncle, I understand was a conductor of a symphony orchestra for a while.
That's right. He was a conductor of a symphony orchestra. He had it de-organized one time.
